title: What's the one tool that 10x'd your launch?
author: Jonah Reyes
body: We're launching next week and finalising our stack. Curious what single tool made the biggest difference to your launch day — distribution, analytics, anything.

replies.author: Priya Nair
replies.body: Honestly, a warm email list beat everything. Build it months before.

replies.author: Sam Whitfield
replies.body: Attribution from day one. You can't fix what you can't see.

title: Self-hosted analytics — worth the hassle in 2026?
author: Lena Fischer
body: Privacy is great but I keep wondering if I'm spending founder-hours babysitting a server. Where's the line for you?

replies.author: Raj D.
replies.body: One binary + a cheap VPS = basically zero maintenance now. Do it.

title: How do you price a micro-SaaS at launch?
author: Ben Carter
body: Freemium, free trial, or straight paid? I keep flip-flopping. What worked for your first 100 customers?

replies.author: Omar Haddad
replies.body: Charge from day one. Free users give feedback you can't bank.

replies.author: Grace Lin
replies.body: Free trial converted 3x better than freemium for us.

title: Best 'built with' stack for a solo founder right now?
author: Chris Vaughn
body: Starting fresh. Optimising for speed-to-ship and low ops. What's your default 2026 stack?

replies.author: Tariq Nasser
replies.body: Next.js on Vercel + Supabase. Boring and unbeatable for solo.

title: Show us your maker origin story
author: Mira Adeyemi
body: What made you build your product? Drop the one-line version. I'll start: I couldn't stick to a single habit, so I built a tracker that only lets you track one.

title: Cold email in 2026 — dead or just harder?
author: Jonah Reyes
body: Reply rates are down but the deals we do close from it are our best. Anyone else seeing this?

replies.author: Dana L.
replies.body: Personalisation is the whole game now. Generic = spam folder.
